title: Renew Your Energy: CBT Program for Depression
summary: A seven-module CBT journey combining psychoeducation, thought skills, activation, and relapse planning to improve mood and daily functioning.

modules.title: Understanding Depression
modules.overview: Clarify emotional, cognitive, physical, and behavioral signs of depression and map your own pattern.
takeaways: Early signs can be recognized and acted on.
exercises: Create a symptom map with recent examples.
Write possible contributors across stress, biology, and context.
homework: Track two mood dips and context this week.
List support resources and questions for care professionals.

modules.title: Thoughts, Emotions, and Behaviors
modules.overview: Learn the CBT model and challenge recurring negative thought patterns with evidence-based reframing.
takeaways: Thoughts can be examined and updated.
exercises: Fill one thought record per day.
Label cognitive distortions in recurring thoughts.
homework: Reframe one high-impact thought each day.

aiSupport.systemPrompt: Act as a CBT support coach. Help apply one concrete exercise at a time and check safety boundaries.
